open_items: ILO: degraded at cycle 1372 (current), contract-only -- six of twelve contract assertions (auth:listing, constraint:availableconstraint, errors:missing_artefact, references:all, references:contentconstraint, references:descendants) read broken/skipped with observed 403, while all five main health checks (gateway+direct metadata/data/json) stayed clean and /api/history shows ILO healthy throughout 1370-1372 (the monitor's history-vs-contracts blind spot, not re-verified but matching prior notes). Live recheck at 12:46Z: every one of those URLs now answers cleanly (200, or 500 for availableconstraint as architecturally expected) -- the block has already cleared. This is the same chronic ILO periodic-403 pattern tracked since cycle 1342, sixth-plus occurrence, but the first time it showed up as contract-only without touching the main health checks. Watch cycle 1373 to confirm it clears from /api/status too; no code action.

ESTAT: flapped twice between runs -- gateway_issue at 1369 (list_dataflows timeout, already reported), healthy at 1370, gateway_issue again at 1371 (this time the empty-'Error:' bug), healthy at 1372. Both occurrences already resolved. No action needed unless gateway_issue recurs for more than one consecutive cycle.

ABS: single-cycle flap at cycle 1371, same empty-'Error:' bug as ESTAT in the identical cycle, healthy again at 1372. Flagged because two endpoints hit the generic empty-error bug in the same cycle, consistent with a shared transient condition rather than independent bugs. Not fixed by this routine.
IMF: single-cycle flap at cycle 1370, 'direct data: ReadTimeout:' (a new shape, not the empty-error bug), healthy again at 1371-1372. Resolved before this run looked at it.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1372. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 161 as of this run (161 last run), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug noted previously: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. Confirmed again this run on ILO at cycle 1372.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences), ESTAT (cycle 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371), ECB (cycle 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357), and IMF (cycle 1368). It is generic exception-handling code, not endpoint-specific, and has hit 4 of 12 endpoints so far. Not fixed by this routine; it only commits to docs/monitor/.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time across ABS/FBOS/ILO/SBS/OECD (seen again this run on ABS), verdict stays ok as always.

This routine's own network occasionally hangs on direct requests to ECB specifically (TLS handshake completes, then no response for 20-30s) while the monitor's own result and other providers are fine in the same window -- seen again this run, previously catalogued around cycle 1348. Not an ECB incident; a quirk of this routine's egress.
